input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for bgm, user, video. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with base functionality, so that I can accomplish my base-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with bgm functionality, so that I can accomplish my bgm-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with video functionality, so that I can accomplish my video-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use bgm capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
